# E-commerce Support Chatbot - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Full-stack chatbot application for e-commerce customer support with AI integration.

## Tech Stack
- **Backend**: Python FastAPI
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 + TypeScript
- **AI**: OpenAI/Anthropic API
- **UI**: Shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS
